text: id: FOD000001 name: Pootharekulu alternate_names: - Atreyapuram Pootharekulu - Paper Sweet origin_place_id: LOC000014 category: Sweet / Dessert dietary_type: Vegetarian gi_tag_certified: True key_ingredients: - Jaya rice batter starch paper - Powdered Sugar / Jaggery - Pure Ghee - Dry fruits / Nuts description: A legendary wafer-thin sweet crepe crafted by layering delicate rice starch sheets with ghee and sugar/jaggery.
